title: ppdo-cli reference data: the schema file of one table
description: schema/<table>.yaml in the folder reference-data: the columns, the filter and the options that 'ppdo-cli dv data export', 'ppdo-cli dv data import' and 'ppdo-cli dv data delete' use for one table.

table.description: The logical name of the table. It must be the same as the name of the file.

match.description: The match key. Only the primary key column is supported in this version: a record is identified by its GUID, in each environment. Leave it out, or write the primary key column.

columns.description: The columns to export and import, in the order of the data file. Do not write the primary key: each record has it. A lookup is the GUID of its target; give a GUID that is different in one environment in an overlay. The bytes of a file column or an image column are saved as a file in data/files/<table>.

layout.description: table: one data file for the table, data/tables/<table>.yaml. record: one data file for each record, data/tables/<table>/<identifier>.yaml.

filter.description: An OData $filter expression. The records that it selects are the scope of the table.

fetchXmlFilter.description: FetchXML <filter> and <link-entity> elements, or a full <fetch> document as in a Configuration Migration Tool schema (its <entity> gives the elements). Use it only when $filter cannot give the same result.

write.description: upsert: create and update. create: a seed table: create the records that are missing, and never update a record that exists (the import lists it as kept); --write-upsert updates it in one run.

files.description: The files of the file, image and base64 columns of this table in data/files/<table>.

relationships.description: The many-to-many relationships of this table to export and import. Write a relationship in the schema file of one of its two tables only. The other table must also have a schema file.

logicalName.description: The logical name of a table or a column (lower case).

write.description: create: write this column only when the import creates the record.

nullValues.description: For this column, in place of nullValues of the table.

file.description: For a file, image or base64 column: the file name pattern of this column, in place of files.name of the table.

filePattern.description: The path of a file in data/files/<table>, made by the export. Tokens: {$id} (the GUID of the record), {$column}, {$filename} (the file name in Dataverse), {$stem} and {$ext} (that name without its extension, and the extension), {<column>} (a column of the schema) and {<lookup column>.name} (the name of the target). A / makes a folder. The paths must be unique in the table; {$id} makes them unique. The import reads the path in the data file, not the pattern.

nullValues.description: What a null in the data file does in the import. clear: remove the value in the target environment. ignore: do nothing, so a record that exists keeps its value and a new record gets the default value of Dataverse.

delete.description: The delete options of this table. If a table has no delete options, dv data delete deletes nothing in that table, and the import never deletes.

mode.description: off: delete nothing. manifest: delete the records of the deletion log (data/.deleted), which the export writes when a record is deleted in the source environment. mirror: also delete each record that is in the scope in the target environment and is not in the data file.

action.description: delete: delete the record. deactivate: set statecode to inactive.

missingLookup.description: What the import does when it cannot find the target of a lookup. error: stop before the first write. skip: write the record without the column, and report it. A new record has no value in the column, and a record that exists keeps its value.

plugins.description: Skip custom synchronous logic, custom asynchronous logic, or the two, for the writes of this table. Needs a group in the mode full.

flows.description: true: do not start cloud flows for the writes of this table.

batchSize.description: The number of records in one bulk request.

name.description: The schema name of a many-to-many relationship.

mode.description: off: only add links. manifest: also remove the links of the deletion log (data/.deleted), which the export writes when a link is removed in the source environment. mirror: also remove a link of a listed record when the link is not in the data file.
